Aqua Light Toner

Replenish. Rebalance. Begin beautifully.

$58.00

Formula:
Aqua, Glyceryl Glucoside, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Ethylhexylglycerin, 1,2-Hexanediol, Betaine, Trehalose, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ergothioneine, Ectoin.

Efficacy:
Skin rejuvenation where water can quickly provide the necessary moisture for the skin. Relieve the discomfort of dry and tight skin and balance the pH of the skin. It strengthens the skin’s self-defense system, replenish moisture, soften the cuticle and make other skin care products easier to be absorbed. It also regulates oil and moisture and makes the skin balance the water-oil composition to have a balance tone with sea Algae sugar, etc. These ingredients can penetrate deep into the bottom layer of the skin, lock in moisture and keep the skin moist for a long time. Skin metabolism requires a large amount of water, which can increase the moisture content of the skin. Improve the problems of dryness and water shortage.
